sections.text_helper: Section 24.6.1 "OPAMP control/status register (OPAMP_CSR)" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 741.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 LOCK: OPAMP_CSR register lock
This bit is write-once. It is set by software. It can only be cleared by a system reset.
This bit is used to configure the OPAMP_CSR register as read-only.
0: OPAMP_CSR is read-write
1: OPAMP_CSR is read-only
Bit 30 CALOUT: Operational amplifier calibration output
This bit reflects the digital value of OPAMP output when OPAINTOEN bit is low. During the
input offset calibration procedure, it provides the indication that the target trimming value is
reached, by transiting from 1 to 0.
The bit cannot be used as long as the OPAINTOEN bit is high.
Bit 29 TSTREF: OPAMP calibration reference voltage output control
This bit is reserved for test. When set, OPAMP outputs the calibration reference voltage.
0: Does not output calibration reference voltage
1: Outputs calibration reference voltage
Bits 28:24 TRIMOFFSETN[4:0]: Trim for NMOS differential pairs
Upon reset, this bitfield is loaded with the factory trimming value. It can only be modified
when the USERTRIM bit is set.
Bits 23:19 TRIMOFFSETP[4:0]: Trim for PMOS differential pairs
Upon reset, this bitfield is loaded with the factory trimming value. It can only be modified
when the USERTRIM bit is set.
Bits 18:14 PGA_GAIN[4:0]: Operational amplifier programmable gain and PGA flavor primary control
This bitfield selects the programmable gain (bits [2:1]) and the PGA flavor ([bits 4:3]). Positive
numbers represent positive gain (noninverting PGA), negative numbers negative gain
(inverting PGA).
00000: gain 2
00001: gain 4
00010: gain 8
00011: gain 16
01000: gain -1 / gain 2 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01001: gain -3 / gain 4 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01010: gain -7 / gain 8 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01011: gain -15 / gain 16 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
10000: gain 2 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10001: gain 4 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10010: gain 8 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10011: gain 16 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
11000: gain -1 / gain 2 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11001: gain -3 / gain 4 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11010: gain -7 / gain 8 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11011: gain -15 / gain 16 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
Other: Not used
Bits 13:12 CALSEL[1:0]: Calibration selection
This bitfield selects the offset calibration reference voltage applied on the operational
amplifier inputs when CALON and FORCE_VP bits are set.
00: 0.033*VDDA
01: 0.1*VDDA (for PMOS calibration)
10: 0.5*VDDA
11: 0.9*VDDA (for NMOS calibration)
Bit 11 CALON: Calibration mode enable
This bitfield disables or enables the calibration mode.
0: Calibration mode disabled
1: Calibration mode enabled
Bits 10:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 8 OPAINTOEN: Operational amplifier internal output enable
This bit determines where the operational amplifier output is connected, either to the
OPAMP_VOUT pin or internally to a COMP channel.
0: OPAMP_VOUT pin
1: COMP channel
Bit 7 OPAHSM: Operational amplifier high-speed mode
This bit determines the speed (slew rate) of the operational amplifier.
0: Normal speed
1: High speed
Only change this configuration when OPAMP is disabled.
Bits 6:5 VM_SEL[1:0]: Inverting input primary selection
This bitfield determines where the operational amplifier inverting input is connected to.
00: OPAMP_VINM0 pin
01: OPAMP_VINM1 pin
10: Internal resistor divider middle point
11: Operational amplifier output
The setting 10 is for the PGA use cases. With this setting, the connection of the
OPAMP_VINM0 and OPAMP_VINM1 pins is determined by the PGA_GAIN[4:0] bitfield.
The setting 11 sets OPAMP in follower mode. With the other two settings, OPAMP is
configured as a stand-alone operational amplifier.
Bit 4 USERTRIM: User trimming enable
This bit enables the user trimming of the operational amplifier input offset. When set, the
TRIMOFFSETN[4:0] and TRIMOFFSETP[4:0] bitfields, loaded with factory trimming values
upon reset, become writable. This allows modifying the input offset trimming values by the
user.
0: Disable (trimming by user not possible)
1: Enable (trimming by user possible)
Bits 3:2 VP_SEL[1:0]: Noninverting input primary selection
This bitfield determines where the operational amplifier noninverting input is connected to.
00: OPAMP_VINP0 pin
01: OPAMP_VINP1 pin
10: OPAMP_VINP2 pin
11: OPAMP_VINP3 pin or DAC output channel
Refer to Section24.3: OPAMP implementation for OPAMP instance-dependent information.
Bit 1 FORCE_VP: Force internal reference on noninverting input
This bit is reserved for test. It allows forcing the calibration reference voltage selected
through the CALSEL[1:0] bitfield on the operational amplifier noninverting input.
0: Do not force (normal operation)
1: Force
Bit 0 OPAEN: Operational amplifier enable
This bit enables and disables the operational amplifier.
0: Disable
1: Enable
